cards.card_text: Their throats are open graves, and their tongues practice deceit.
cards.verse_text: For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.

cards.card_text: Then the quotes zoom in on the body: their throats are open graves, their tongues practice deceit, and the venom of vipers is on their lips.
cards.verse_text: “Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.” “The venom of vipers is on their lips.” “Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness.”
